SELECT ticker, "date", close FROM sec.stock_prices WHERE ticker IN ('XLU.US','GRID.US') AND "date" >= '2026-11-05' AND "date" <= '2026-11-12' ORDER BY ticker, "date"
SELECT ticker, "date", close FROM sec.stock_prices WHERE ticker IN ('XLU.US') AND ("date" IN ('2025-12-31','2026-10-09','2026-10-08','2026-10-12')) ORDER BY "date"
